title: Lineb
description: config.ini [Lineb] section (LinebConfig). Keys, defaults, and allowed values.

initial_path.description: Multi-frame seed band (neb.con). Interior images must start at or above energy plus the turning width.

energy.description: Tunneling energy E of the equipotential endpoints, eV.

opt_tol.description: Mass-weighted stop on the nudged force.

perp_tol.description: Mass-weighted stop on the perpendicular action gradient.

linear_seed.description: Join the initial turning points with a straight path.

endpoint_convergence.description: Apply opt_tol to the endpoints and perp_tol to the interior.

result_cache.description: Path to the rgpot result cache for this LI-NEB job.

interpolated_force_clock.description: Propagate imaginary time with velocity Verlet on the interpolated tangential image force.

projected_verlet.description: Optimize the band with velocity-projected velocity Verlet.

endpoint_kappa.description: Fixed endpoint coefficient; zero selects endpoint_scale.

max_move.description: Step cap; per atom when molecular, else whole-band Euclidean length. 0 leaves the step uncapped.

turning_width.description: Fraction of the highest seed height above E; interiors stay above E+w.

hbar.description: hbar in eV^0.5 amu^0.5 Angstrom. Temperature is hbar/(k_B tau).

quadrature_pairs.description: Simpson pairs per chord for the period quadrature.

beads.description: Harmonic quantum TST replicas. 0 writes the path only (log rate NaN). Must be 0 or at least 2; beads = 1 is refused.

molecular.description: false expands atom masses to coordinates. true uses molecule alignment and needs every atom free.
